page.overview:
Who is Mecha Chocobo?

Mecha Chocobo is a minor character and boss in World of Final Fantasy. It is a Cogna resembling a chocobo that means to create a "new chocobo world order", as it believes chocobos are superior to humans. For reasons unknown, a moogle resides within its body.

Mecha Chocobo is a Cogna that looks like an adult version of the Mecha Choco. It has black circles under its white, glowing eyes, which are shaped to give the Cogna a perpetual "angry" expression; its "plumage" consists of three pointed adornments affixed to the back of its head, with yellow-tinted spires sticking out of each of them; its "wings" are round and wide, and the undersides of them are a light shade of black, and act as compartments that house pairs of guns; its "tailfeathers" are sharp, lined with black, and contain a large thruster under them; and its "talons" are large, sharp, and contain a single large wheel under each of them.

Its main body is a simple spherical shape; the front of it has a hatch that leads to a compartment in its body, signified by the black outline that resembles the silhouette of a certain creature. In the center of the hatch is a small, rectangular slot with a curved portion cut out of the bottom of it.

The slot in the hatch shows very little of the being that resides within it, but it is enough to confirm that it is a moogle. Like most of its kind, the moogle sports yellow fur, slanted eyes, and a big, red nose.
